# Logic reference

The vocabulary of the logic language, as the engine reads it. The narrative — how conditions, calculations, piping and set expressions fit together, with worked examples — is in *Logic and expressions*.

## Comparison operators

Each operator's spellings, canonical first (the one the Studio prints). The camelCase name is always accepted.

| operator | spellings | operand |
|---|---|---|
| `eq` | `=`, `==`, `is`, `eq` | one |
| `ne` | `!=`, `is not`, `ne` | one |
| `gt` | `>`, `gt` | one |
| `gte` | `>=`, `gte` | one |
| `lt` | `<`, `lt` | one |
| `lte` | `<=`, `lte` | one |
| `between` | `between` | two (`X and Y`) |
| `notBetween` | `not between`, `notBetween` | two (`X and Y`) |
| `in` | `in` | a list `[a, b]` |
| `notIn` | `not in`, `notIn` | a list `[a, b]` |
| `contains` | `contains` | one |
| `notContains` | `not contains`, `notContains` | one |
| `containsAny` | `contains any`, `containsAny` | a list `[a, b]` |
| `containsAll` | `contains all`, `containsAll` | a list `[a, b]` |
| `containsNone` | `contains none`, `containsNone` | a list `[a, b]` |
| `selected` | `selected` | one |
| `notSelected` | `not selected`, `notSelected` | one |
| `answered` | `answered` | none |
| `unanswered` | `unanswered` | none |
| `isEmpty` | `is empty`, `isEmpty` | none |
| `isNotEmpty` | `is not empty`, `isNotEmpty` | none |
| `matches` | `matches` | one |
| `startsWith` | `starts with`, `startsWith` | one |
| `endsWith` | `ends with`, `endsWith` | one |
| `rankedFirst` | `ranked first`, `rankedFirst` | one |
| `rankedLast` | `ranked last`, `rankedLast` | one |
| `rankedTopN` | `ranked top`, `rankedTopN` | two (`X and Y`) |
| `rankEquals` | `rank equals`, `rankEquals` | two (`X and Y`) |
| `rankGreaterThan` | `rank after`, `rankGreaterThan` | two (`X and Y`) |
| `rankLessThan` | `rank before`, `rankLessThan` | two (`X and Y`) |
| `notRanked` | `not ranked`, `notRanked` | one |
| `dateBefore` | `before`, `dateBefore` | one |
| `dateAfter` | `after`, `dateAfter` | one |
| `dateEquals` | `on`, `dateEquals` | one |
| `dateBetween` | `between dates`, `dateBetween` | two (`X and Y`) |

Connectives: `AND` / `&&`, `OR` / `||`, `NOT` / `!`, `NOR` (= NOT (A OR B)), `BUT NOT` (= AND NOT), parentheses. `NOT` binds tighter than `AND`, `AND` tighter than `OR`; mixing `AND` and `OR` without brackets is accepted with a warning.

## Calculation functions

47 functions, usable in calculations, in `{{expr: …}}` piping and inside conditions (an expression in a condition compiles to an `expr` source). Names are case-insensitive.

| group | functions | examples |
|---|---|---|
| Aggregates | `sum`, `avg`, `mean`, `average`, `min`, `max`, `count`, `countif` | `sum(Q1, Q2)`, `avg(ALLOC_*)` (a `*` wildcard over variable names), `countif(Q5_1, Q5_2, ">", 3)` |
| Arithmetic | `pct`, `percent`, `weighted`, `round`, `abs`, `floor`, `ceil`, `ceiling`, `sqrt`, `pow` | `pct(part, whole)`, `weighted(v1, w1, v2, w2, …)`, `round(x, 2)`, `pow(x, y)` |
| Logic and conversion | `if`, `coalesce`, `number`, `text` | `if(Q1 > 18, 1, 0)`, `coalesce(Q2, 0)`, `number("12")`, `text(Q1)` |
| Strings | `len`, `length`, `concat`, `contains`, `upper`, `lower`, `trim`, `substring`, `substr`, `replace`, `startswith`, `endswith`, `regex`, `matches` | `concat(Q1, " ", Q2)`, `contains(Q9, "price")`, `substring(Q9, 0, 10)`, `replace(Q9, "a", "b")` (every occurrence, literal), `matches(Q9, "^[A-Z]")` |
| Dates (UTC midnight) | `today`, `date`, `datediff`, `age`, `dateadd`, `year`, `month`, `day` | `age(DOB)` (calendar years), `datediff(today(), date(Q7))` (days), `dateadd(Q7, 30)` |
| Geo | `distance_km` | `distance_km(Q12, Q13)` between two location answers |
| AI (server-resolved) | `ai_classify`, `ai_sentiment` | `ai_classify(Q9, "Price\|Service\|Quality")`, `ai_sentiment(Q9)` → positive \| neutral \| negative — only as the whole expression of a calculated question |

Operators in a calculation: `+ - * / %`, `== != > < >= <=`, `and` / `&&`, `or` / `||`, `not` / `!`, unary `-`. Strings in double or single quotes. `+` concatenates when either side is a string. Division by zero gives null. Limits: depth 64, 20 000 steps.

## Piping

A token is `{{ … }}` in any question text, instruction, option label, HTML block, end message, redirect or media URL. A question token is `{{CODE}}`, `{{CODE.property}}`, `{{CODE[row].property}}`, with an optional `|format` suffix.

### Properties

| property | meaning | multi-value only |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | Selected option label |  |
| `value` | Selected option value / code |  |
| `labels` | All selected labels | yes |
| `count` | Number of selections | yes |
| `first` | First selected | yes |
| `last` | Last selected | yes |
| `rank` | Ranking order | yes |
| `displayed` | Options displayed | yes |
| `remaining` | Options not selected | yes |
| `other` | “Other, specify” text |  |

### Formats

| format | meaning | example |
|---|---|---|
| `comma` | Comma separated | Apple, Orange, Banana |
| `and` | “and” list | Apple, Orange and Banana |
| `or` | “or” list | Apple, Orange or Banana |
| `bullets` | Bulleted list | • Apple • Orange |
| `numbered` | Numbered list | 1. Apple 2. Orange |
| `lines` | One per line | Apple ⏎ Orange |
| `upper` | UPPERCASE | APPLE |
| `lower` | lowercase | apple |
| `title` | Title Case | Apple |
| `image` | Show as image | a URL becomes the picture it points to |

Also `|join:<separator>`. Namespaces: `{{calc.NAME}}`, `{{ed.NAME}}` / `{{embedded.NAME}}`, `{{loop.label}}` / `.code` / `.index` / `.count` / `.<column>`, `{{<loopVar>.<column>}}` for an outer loop, `{{CURRENT_ITEM}}`, `{{LOOP_INDEX}}`, `{{LOOP_COUNT}}`, `{{expr: Q1 + Q2}}`.

Grammar: `IF <condition> THEN <VERB> Q2.B[, Q2.C] [AND <VERB> Q3.X]`, `ELSE IF <condition> THEN …`, `ELSE <VERB> …`, `SET <Question|VARIABLE> = <code|label|number|"text">`, `CLEAR <Question>`.

## UX behaviour scripts

A behaviour's `script` runs in a sandboxed iframe as `new Function("rs", code)` with a frozen `rs`. Functions: `listen`, `getAnswer`, `getQuestion`, `getBlock`, `getPage`, `addClass`, `removeClass`, `toggleClass`, `animate`, `setStyle`, `clearStyle`, `show`, `hide`, `showMessage`, `hideMessage`, `scrollTo`, `focus`, `after`, `log`. Events: `answer`, `change`, `select`, `deselect`, `click`, `hover`, `page`, `complete`. Aliases: `page_enter` → `page`, `page_load` → `page`, `load` → `page`, `appear` → `page`, `enter` → `page`, `page_complete` → `complete`, `select_option` → `select`, `deselect_option` → `deselect`. Loops, `eval`, `fetch`, `document`, `window` and any attempt to set an answer are rejected before the script is saved; commands are rate-limited to 200 per second.

Methods: `frequencies`, `mean`, `median`, `top_box`, `nps`, `crosstab`, `chi_square`, `t_test`, `anova`, `mann_whitney`, `kruskal_wallis`, `correlation`, `regression`, `logistic_regression`, `factor`, `reliability`, `cluster`, `conjoint_utilities`, `maxdiff_scores`, `turf`, `driver_analysis`, `text_themes`, `ranking_scores`, `allocation_shares`, `pricing`, `brand_funnel`.
